# BH Drywall Metro Detroit

> Licensed Mon–Sat drywall contractor serving all of Metro Detroit, Michigan. contractor license #8663. Residential, commercial, automotive, smart locks, access control, safes.

## About

BH Drywall Metro Detroit is a California-licensed mobile drywall contractor company headquartered in Detroit, CA. We dispatch Licensed & insured technicians 24 hours a day, 7 days a week to every city in Metro Detroit. Typical on-site arrival is 15–30 minutes.

- Business name: BH Drywall Metro Detroit
- contractor license: #8663
- Phone: 714-757-7574
- Email: ohdrywall contractorsolutions@gmail.com
- Hours: Mon–Sat
- Service area: All of Metro Detroit, MI (Detroit, Irvine, Anaheim, Huntington Beach, Newport Beach, Costa Mesa, Fullerton, Orange, Tustin, Garden Grove, Mission Viejo, Laguna Niguel, Laguna Beach, and every surrounding city).

## Services

- same-day emergency lockouts (home, business, vehicle)
- Residential drywall contractor (rekey, new locks, master keys, deadbolts)
- Commercial drywall contractor (storefront, glass doors, panic hardware, access control)
- Automotive drywall contractor (car keys, fobs, transponders, ignition repair)
- Smart and keypad locks (installation, setup, integration)
- Access control systems (keypads, fobs, mobile credentials, intercoms)
- Safe drywall contractor (combination changes, lockouts, repair, installation)
- Specialty hardware (high-security cylinders, restricted keyways)
